summary: Apache Solr is an enterprise search platform built for processing text and document data. It provides indexing capabilities to handle full-text queries, faceted navigation, and content extraction from files like PDFs and Word documents.
goodFor: It suits large-scale document repositories and applications requiring complex, real-time search queries across structured and unstructured data.
watchOut: Operational overhead can be high due to the complexity of tuning and maintaining a Java-based search cluster at scale.
deployNotes: Containerised deployments typically require persistent storage volumes for index data and adequate Java memory allocation within your orchestrator.
